question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Spat
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"spat"** means a petty quarrel or dispute. (तकरार)

 
 
• **Example: **They had a little **spat** over who would clean the kitchen.
 
 
 
• **"Agree" **means to have the same opinion about something; to concur. (सहमति)
 
 
• **Example: **We** agreed **on the terms of the contract without any issues.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'spat' **is **'agree'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Persuade **(मनाना): To cause someone to do something through reasoning or argument.

 
 
• **Example:** She tried to **persuade** him to go to the party.
 
 
 
• **Beguile **(मोह लेना): To charm or enchant someone, sometimes in a deceptive way.
 
 
• **Example: **He** beguiled **the audience with his smooth and soothing voice.
 
 
 
• **Nitpick** (बाल की खाल निकालना): To find fault with someone in a petty way.
 
 
• **Example:** She tends to **nitpick** about the smallest details.
